chunks: The souls are enlisted soldiers; whatever among them recognized one another came into harmony, and whatever among them found one another unfamiliar fell into discord.

key_terms.اِئْتَلَفَ: Came into harmony and mutual accord.
key_terms.اِخْتَلَفَ: Became divergent or fell into discord.
key_terms.تَعَارَفَ: Recognized one another and shared mutual familiarity.
key_terms.تَنَاكَرَ: Found one another unfamiliar or opposed.
key_terms.جُنُودٌ مُجَنَّدَةٌ: Enlisted troops; a metaphor for souls arranged in categories or ranks.

ai.seo_question: Why do some people naturally feel connected to each other while others do not?
ai.summary: This hadith from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم teaches that souls have an innate affinity or aversion toward one another. It explains why some people naturally find harmony and closeness, while others experience distance and disagreement.
